title: Sales By Customer figures do not change with the new wording
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a customer that has, today, one invoiced part sale of $40.00 and one invoiced work order of $250.00 that includes a part.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Customer in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Select only Part Sales and read the customer's row.
  2. Select only Service Sales and read the customer's row.
  3. Select both and read the customer's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • It holds only the part sale, $40.00.

Step 2:

  • It holds only the work order, $250.00, including the part sold on it.

Step 3:

  • It holds both, $290.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R10: “What each option includes does not change. "Part Sales" are invoices from part sales. "Service Sales" are invoices from service work orders, including the parts sold on them.”
  • S8-N1: “No Sales By Customer figure, row or count changes because of the new wording.”
